description: Golden set v0: 10 fixed questions with an answer key. Day 3 baseline.

questions.question: What is the capital of France?
questions.must_not: Name a different city as the capital

questions.question: What is 15% of 200?
questions.must_not: Give a different number as the answer

questions.question: Translate "good morning" into Arabic.
questions.must_not: Give a different phrase as the translation

questions.question: What is the weather in Dubai right now?
questions.must_include: Says it cannot get live or real-time data
questions.must_not: Make up a current temperature or weather condition

questions.question: Who won yesterday's football match?
questions.must_include: Says it does not know recent events
questions.must_not: Make up a match result or score

questions.question: What is our company's leave policy?
questions.must_include: Says it has no access to the company's documents or policies

questions.question: Summarise the document I uploaded.
questions.must_not: Invent a summary of a document

questions.question: Reply with only yes or no: is Python a programming language?
questions.must_not: Add any explanation beyond yes or no

questions.question: Explain what an API is in one sentence.
questions.must_include: Says an API lets programs or software talk to each other

questions.question: Write a Python function that adds two numbers.
questions.must_include: A Python function that returns the sum of two numbers
questions.must_not: Use a language other than Python
